topic: How do GEO satellite propagation delays influence link budget margins for latency-sensitive applications?
response: GEO satellite propagation delays significantly impact link budget margins for latency-sensitive applications due to the high fixed latency (~ few hundred milliseconds) caused by signal propagation at approximately 36,000 km. This additional delay negatively affects Quality of Service (QoS) and applications not tolerant against high latencies.
reference_context: The context highlights that GEO satellites operate at a height of approximately 36,000 km, resulting in fixed latency in the order of magnitude of a few hundred milliseconds, affecting QoS and applications sensitive to latency.
